name: Making Disciples
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively make disciples by teaching and baptizing all nations, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 28:19 and Mark 16:15. True discipleship requires a committed following of Christ, including bearing one's cross (Luke 14:27) and continuing in His word (John 8:31). Genuine discipleship is evidenced by bearing lasting spiritual fruit that glorifies the Father (John 15:8, 15:16), reflecting the divine calling to produce enduring fruit through Christ’s chosen people.
